name: Spaceship 9242617e on the 3-uniform tiling k3-053
description: A period-26 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-053 (touching neighbours), 3 to 7 cells, moving one lattice step every 26 generations (c/26). It runs the same way in the 16,384 rules from B36/S25 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S0,2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 642 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
